gate_rule: If development sensitivity has a positive no-miss/no-verified-regression signal above two-replica noise and both tiny fits are exact, train 2000 producer macro decisions/run. Otherwise train only 512/run for engineering validation; no scaling claim. Pilot also requires on-device warm p95 inference <=20ms; otherwise use the engineering budget. Applied delay is quantized to the next kernel boundary.
training: cooperative macro MAPPO, fixed receiver/reverse roles, raw v6 task reward, no shaping or teacher subtraction
validation: all six final models, fixed new 12-case validation bank, no selection or tuning; original reserved tests untouched
scope: bounded pilot, not the planned long 50k-macro study; two replicas are a descriptive sensitivity check, not statistical proof
seed_allocation: All 48 case IDs checked disjoint from seed-labeled fields in existing public artifact/config JSON; calibration cases allocated but unused
